about: Curated stops for the northern Canada corridor, east (Highway 6 in Manitoba, Routes 113, 167, 172 and 138 in Quebec), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. A stop whose season is not 'year round' is left out.

truck_access.about: Stops whose tractor-trailer access was read from a source, and those where it is assumed with the reason in source. These are town stations and provincial rest areas on long two-lane highways with no truck source either way.

stops.name: Esso Senneterre
stops.source: Position, name and brand read from OSM node 7860165459, OpenStreetMap planet extract 2026-11-16, on Route 113 at Senneterre. Diesel read from its fuel:diesel=yes tag; year-round opening assumed, not read. Tractor-trailer access assumed: on this remote highway freight moves by tractor-trailer and these are its only diesel between the towns; parking capacity is not claimed, so the stop offers fuel only. Leg mile projected onto the leg's road.
